goal: Advance Chu-kei Insight Plan Detection from 375/3,709 (10.11%) to at least 928 resolved companies (>=25%). Prioritize company-count breadth. Align public/site data and release metadata with the canonical universe/registry, then expand in bounded resumable batches using reviewed evidence and official/first-party IR sources. Never weaken review gates, infer missing evidence into resolved states, or add unrelated features.
graduation_criteria: Canonical registry/public summary reach >=25% coverage (>=928/3,709; recalculate ceil(universe*0.25) if the authoritative universe changes).
Each newly resolved company has official/first-party evidence with source identity, dates/period semantics and provenance; ambiguous, stale or unreviewed evidence stays unresolved.
Complete review evidence before derived registry/site rebuilds; preserve formal-plan/full-text/no-inference safeguards and regression tests.

Frontend manifest, Plan Detection summary and release metadata match canonical data; repository-side sync/smoke checks have no deterministic blocker, and external hosting actions are recorded explicitly.
Relevant tests, source/audit checks, quality gates and resumable-pipeline checks are green, and ADE remains resumable beyond 25%.
